# SaaSy Land

> A SaaS starter kit your AI coding agent can’t quietly break: plain code in the stack you choose, with no framework of ours underneath, sign-in on your own database, an admin, a customer workspace, docs and a blog in every supported language, an AGENTS.md for coding agents, and a code-coverage gate that fails CI. Its CLI generates a React project with TanStack Start on Cloudflare Workers and D1, with or without sign-in, from the options its configurator lets you pick; billing, the other frameworks and the other options are on the roadmap. The website’s own source is MIT licensed, so you can start from it for free.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://saasyland.com/docs): installation, architecture, features and guides
- [Getting started](https://saasyland.com/docs/getting-started): prerequisites, installation and first run
- [CLI](https://saasyland.com/docs/cli): running the CLI, creating a project, licence activation, CI and exit codes
- [Test coverage](https://saasyland.com/docs/tooling/test-coverage): what each layer of tests proves, and every user and admin flow with the browser test that proves it or what is missing
- [CLI release notes](https://saasyland.com/docs/cli/releases): what each CLI release changed
- [Roadmap](https://saasyland.com/docs/project/roadmap): what is available now and what is arriving

## Product

- [Pricing](https://saasyland.com/#pricing): Core, Complete and Agency licences, each card split into what is available now and what is arriving
- [Blog](https://saasyland.com/blog): release notes and articles
